practice_standard._doc: Declared source classes for the practice pipeline (Item 320 Part 9, 29 Oct 2026). Read by practice.py before any read and by the standard generation; one definition.

two_windows.Window test: measures our reading: the most recent date of ours on the row must fall inside the window (Item 320 Part 1 ruling)
two_windows.practice window: measures the signal’s currency: the signal’s publication date must fall inside the window (Item 320 Part 8 ruling); the read date on the line dates our check

sunbiz.what: Florida Division of Corporations — reads only, never writes; stays at 0 reads absent a Chair ruling revisiting the Part 6 ceiling and the 0-Sunbiz posture

job_board.what: job boards, for the Fractionals criterion

practice_standard.company_site: not a source for any criterion
practice_standard.no_signal_found_rule: derived only when every declared source class permitted for the criterion was read for the row and nothing returned; the classes read are logged on the row

read_cost.measured: Part 7 measured a median 0.47 s per read on 135 reads; cost in reads per row per class is measured in this part and stated in bot-report-part9.json

Acquisitions.what: sale posture, succession or ownership transition
Acquisitions.source_rule: third parties only (brokers, trade press, registries); never the company's own site

Fractionals.what: a published finance or operations vacancy, an interim-leadership announcement, or a first-finance-hire posting
Fractionals.source_rule: a published posting or announcement, with its source and date

Private Equity.what: a Florida sponsor's published portfolio, platform or add-on announcement
Private Equity.source_rule: the sponsor's or the press's publication, with its source and date

practice_standard.rule: derived from dated signal lines and read-no-signal lines on the row; never typed; the bot's Part 7 sentences enter as not read until a human reads them; a signal dated outside the window reads no signal found

measured: 2026-10-29 (classifier pass: trading check dated on its own line; source_state from the Src line; Band 2 second entry; no sourced row labelled unsourced)
